address.title: E-mail address
address.unverifiedBody: Until you follow the link in the letter you can look around, but not create Alerts or link a chat.

chat.title: Telegram
chat.purpose: Notifications are sent to the Telegram chat you link here. Without one your Alerts still go off and appear in History, but nothing is sent anywhere.
chat.linked: Linked to chat {{id}}. Notifications go there.
chat.stepStart: Open {{bot}} in Telegram and press Start. Do this first: until you do, our bot is not allowed to write to you, and saving is refused.
chat.stepStartUnnamed: Open our bot in Telegram and press Start. Its name could not be loaded just now — reload the page in a minute.
chat.stepNumber: Then get your chat's number from a third-party bot such as @userinfobot: write it anything, and it answers with your id. Type that number below.
chat.warning: It is not ours. The moment you write to it, it sees your Telegram account — your name, username and id — and we cannot tell what it does with them. If that is too much, skip Telegram: your Alerts still go off and appear in History.
chat.fieldHint: Digits only. Saving sends a test message to that chat, and the number is kept only if it arrives.
chat.save: Save and send a test message
chat.saved: Saved: the test message has been delivered to that chat.
chat.unlinked: Unlinked. Your Alerts keep working; Notifications stop.
chat.unlinkFailed: Could not unlink the chat. Try again in a moment.
chat.demo: The demo account cannot link a Telegram chat. It is shared, so a chat linked here would receive the Notifications of everyone who signs in. To try Notifications, create an account of your own and link your chat there.

errors.invalid: Enter the number only: digits, with no spaces or minus sign. Group chats are not supported.
errors.notStarted: Telegram would not deliver to this chat: it has not pressed Start on our bot yet, or the number is wrong. Do the first step, then save again.
errors.blocked: This chat has blocked our bot. Unblock it in Telegram, then save again.
errors.taken: This chat is already linked to another account.
errors.unverified: Confirm your e-mail address first — the banner at the top of the screen can send the letter again.
errors.limited_one: Too many refused attempts. Try again in {{count, number}} minute.
errors.limited_other: Too many refused attempts. Try again in {{count, number}} minutes.
errors.limitedSoon: Too many refused attempts. Try again later.
errors.unavailable: Telegram is not answering right now. Nothing was saved; try again in a minute.

digest.title: Daily Digest
digest.switch: Send me the Daily Digest by e-mail
digest.contents: Once a day at {{time}} your time, to {{email}}: the Triggers of the last 24 hours, newest first (up to 50, the rest in History), and the Alerts that finished in that time.
digest.contentsNoTime: Once a day, to {{email}}: the Triggers of the last 24 hours, newest first (up to 50, the rest in History), and the Alerts that finished in that time.
digest.quiet: A day with nothing to report sends no mail.
digest.off: Off until you turn it on.
digest.demo: On the demo account the Digest goes to the project's own mailbox, which nobody signed in here can read, and the switch is turned back off every day at {{time}}.
digest.demoNoTime: On the demo account the Digest goes to the project's own mailbox, which nobody signed in here can read, and the switch is turned back off every night.
digest.unverified: Confirm your e-mail address first: the Digest is sent to it.
digest.failed: Could not change the setting. Try again in a moment.
